run_preprocess_relaxed_cli: run the CLI script to preprocess relaxed trajectory files into LMDB graph feature databases for S2EF
run_write_images_to_lmdb: run write_images_to_lmdb to convert ASE trajectory samples into pickled graph objects stored in an LMDB database
run_main_preprocess_split: run main to preprocess a single split of .traj files into chunked LMDB databases using multiprocessing
review_atoms_to_graphs_config: review the AtomsToGraphs initialization with max_neigh=50, radius=6, and edge and fixed atom features enabled
review_lmdb_preprocessing_pipeline: review the multiprocessing LMDB preprocessing pipeline that splits trajectory files across workers for parallel graph feature extraction
